Canvas 101

Learn how you and Copilot work in one shared space.

Lesson

What is a canvas?

You're probably used to working with your agent through chat. But chat isn't always the best modality for every kind of work. That's why we built canvases.

A canvas is a shared, interactive surface for a work artifact, such as a plan, triage board, dashboard, release checklist, or spreadsheet. You and your agent both work on it.

What can a canvas be?

A few community canvases from Awesome Copilot:

  • Agent Radar maps the Copilot agents on your computer and what they're doing.
  • AI Credits Breakdown shows where your AI credits go, by day, repo and model.
  • Artifact Explorer browses pull requests, workflow runs and their artifacts.
  • Apng Studio lets you draw frames and export an animated PNG.

In this lesson

The ticket on the right is a canvas. Its goal: help you build order tickets.

(Technically, this whole lesson is a canvas too. But you get the point.)

Make a change yourself

  1. Click Add Omelette in the ticket canvas.
  2. You should see the quantity of omelettes increase on your ticket.
  3. Feel free to add other dishes, remove them, or click Clear ticket.

What's happening under the hood

A canvas is a web app. Each button sends an action, like add_dish, to the canvas's server, which updates the ticket. That's what makes it useful: you can make changes directly, without writing a prompt.

Let the agent make a change

Now it's time to see how your agent can interact with the canvas.

  1. Click Send prompt to agent.
  2. In your chat, you should see the prompt Add two Soups to my ticket. appear.
  3. The agent should start working on adding the Soups.
  4. View your ticket to see the two Soups added to it.

What's happening under the hood

The canvas gives the agent a list of actions it can call, like add_dish. When you ask for Soup, the agent calls the same add_dish action your button used, so you're both changing the same ticket.

Check the result together

You can also ask the agent directly about anything on the canvas in chat.

  1. Remove one Soup from your ticket by clicking Remove.
  2. In your chat, type Summarize my current order, including quantities.
  3. Compare the agent's answer with your actual ticket.

What's happening under the hood

The agent doesn't remember the ticket from chat. It calls get_ticket to read the live state, including your edits. That's why a canvas is a trustworthy shared source of truth.
